# furina-dsh-theme · 芙宁娜 / Fontaine theme for DeepSeek Harness

A complete web-theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: three Furina / 芙宁娜
skins, a wallpaper

layer you can switch on its own, translucent glass surfaces, a
芙宁娜主题 section inside DSH's own Settin

gs dialog, a themed startup splash and
readable file cards — no rebuild, no patched markup, no `!imp

d startup splash and
readable file cards — no rebuild, no patched markup, no `!important` arms race.

Repository: **https://github.com/TanPass/furina-dsh-theme** ·
Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add

github:TanPass/furina-dsh-theme` ·
Issues: https://github.com/TanPass/furina-dsh-theme/issues

All six images are real 1600×900 captures of throwaway DSH instances (isolated
`DSH_HOME`, ports 308

3/3084) — see Verification. The five round-1
captures under `docs/` (`screenshot-switcher-open.png`

etc.) are kept as history:
they show the old floating switcher that round 2 replaced.
## What you get

* **Three skins**, each a full palette (background, surfaces, text hierarchy, four
accents, semantic

colours) mapped onto DSH's own `--dsh-*` design tokens, so every
stock component — sidebar, compose

r, message bubbles, code blocks, menus — re-skins
without touching application markup.

## Requirements

* DSH with the Web GUI (`dsh web`), profile `web`. **Tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**;
`engines.dsh` decla

res the supported range `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`, so the
plugin manager refuses it on 0.3+ instead of

loading half of it.
* Node 22+ (only for the plugin process; the browser half is plain ES5-era JS).

* **No other full-page theme enabled.** Themes that repaint the entire shell — notably
`dsh-theme-e

ndfield` / `dsh-endfield-theme` — override the same `--dsh-*` tokens and
paint their own opaque laye

r over the app. They are not broken, but they will win:
enable one theme at a time. See Coexistence.
### DSH 0.2.2 compatibility notes
1.2.8 is the first release built against DSH 0.2.2. What changed and why:

* **Agent preset** (`preset/furina-preset/agent.cordis.yml`) — the
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-c

ontrol/list-agents` row is gone: that subpath
export was removed in 0.2.2 (`list_agents` is register

ed by the main package
now), and an unresolvable row makes the whole preset fail to mount, so every

new session that selected 芙宁娜 reported `agent-preset/invalid`.
`modelSelectionSettings` became `mode

lSelection` + `modelDiscovery`; the old
key is silently ignored by 0.2.2, which cost the subagent to

ol its
model-facing parameters and the `list_subagent_models` tool.
**If you installed the preset be

fore this release, rewrite the block once**
after upgrading: `node tools/install-preset.mjs` replace

s only the plugin's
own marker block with the fixed rows (the settings-pane button is a toggle —
cli

cking 已安装 removes it, so click again to install the fixed version).
* **`engines.dsh`** is now decla

red, so 0.3 will refuse the plugin instead of
loading it unconstrained.
* **`dsh-cost-meter` floor i

s `^1.9.52`** — the first release that targets the
0.2.2 service-provision records. Older 1.8.x copi

es can miss isolated services
on a 0.2.2 host.
* **Startup-animation installer** now copies the vend

ored
`dsh-startup-screen` to `<DSH_HOME>/plugins/dsh-startup-screen` and points the
profile's `file:

` dependency there. It used to point into the theme package's
own install directory, which lives ins

ide pnpm's `.pnpm/<hash>/` and can be
pruned by the next `dsh plugin` operation.
* **Shipped agent p

resets can disappear next to billion-context.** That bundle's
patch injects `biliBasicCompactionPoli

cy` into the four shipped preset rows
(`preset-standard` / `-ptc` / `-minimal` / `-cordis`). On 0.2.

2 the service
never reaches the preset scope, so the rows stay `pending` and the new-session
picker

only offers custom presets — the install itself looks fine, which makes
it hard to attribute. `insta

ll/install.ps1` now detects that profile shape
(billion-context + dsh-web-app in `dsh.profile.bundle

s`) and appends a marked,
[该节后续省略]
### Limitations of the evidence

* Screenshots are 1600×900 headless-Chromium captures of throwaway profiles; they
prove mount + pain

t + switching, not every component state (dialogs, streaming
transcripts) in every skin.
* `splash-b

oot.png` is a **real boot** capture (isolated instance with the installed
`dsh-startup-screen` kept

in the bundle list, splash forced to `mode: always`,
captured at ~6.6 s). The port-3083/3084 instanc

es are throwaway: the live GUI and
the installed theme copy under `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/

furina-dsh-theme`
were never touched.
* `file-card.png` renders the changed-file and presented-file

*`, loaded from its `data-plugin-css` modules) and data attributes; there
is no agent transcript in

a throwaway profile, so the card content is seeded rather
than produced by a real tool call.
* The s

ettings page is injected into the app's dialog (a cloned nav row + an
absolutely positioned Shadow D

OM pane). It follows the app's DOM contract, not a
public plugin slot, so a future Settings redesign

may need the selectors refreshed;
the fallback launcher keeps the controls reachable in that case.

* The isolated instance runs with the two full-page competitor themes removed — that
is the supporte

d configuration, not a hidden workaround (see
Coexistence).
* The theme is CSS-first: it re-skins DS

H's design tokens and a bounded set of
surfaces. It does not restyle third-party plugin UI that hard
-codes its own colours.
### Dependencies and privacy

* one new runtime dependency: `dsh-cost-meter` (the service that owns the ledger);
* the panel reuse

are read, logged or sent anywhere by this plugin — the panel
only asks the local host process.
